args:
#!/bin/sh
# agentflow project launcher (generated by `agentflow init`; commit it).
# Runs the installed agentflow, or bootstraps the latest stable release on first use.
# After that the binary updates itself in the background. Progress goes to stderr so
# MCP stdout stays clean.
set -eu

home="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/agentflow"
tag=
if [ "${1:-}" = --bootstrap-release ]; then
  tag=${2:-}
  printf '%s\n' "$tag" | grep -Eq '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' || { echo 'agentflow: invalid stable release tag' >&2; exit 1; }
  shift 2
fi
if [ -x "$home/current/agentflow" ] && { [ -z "$tag" ] || [ "$(cd "$home/current" && pwd -P)" = "$(cd "$home" && pwd -P)/${tag#v}" ]; }; then
  exec "$home/current/agentflow" "$@"
fi

command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
  echo "agentflow: first run needs the GitHub CLI (gh) logged in to github.com" >&2
  exit 1
}

os=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64|amd64) arch=amd64 ;;
  arm64|aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo "agentflow: unsupported architecture $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [ -z "$tag" ]; then tag=$(gh release view --repo nscaledev/agentflow --json tagName -q .tagName); fi
ver=${tag#v}
pkg="agentflow_${ver}_${os}_${arch}.tar.gz"
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT INT TERM

echo "agentflow: first run, installing $tag" >&2
gh release download "$tag" --repo nscaledev/agentflow --dir "$tmp" \
  --pattern "$pkg" --pattern checksums.txt >&2

if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sum="sha256sum"; else sum="shasum -a 256"; fi
(cd "$tmp" && grep " $pkg\$" checksums.txt | $sum -c -) >&2 || {
  echo "agentflow: checksum mismatch for $pkg, not installing" >&2
  exit 1
}
gh attestation verify "$tmp/$pkg" --repo nscaledev/agentflow \
  --signer-workflow nscaledev/agentflow/.github/workflows/release.yml >&2 || {
  echo "agentflow: build attestation did not verify, not installing" >&2
  exit 1
}

# Install atomically: extract into a private staging dir, then rename the binary into
# place, so concurrent first runs (several AI clients starting at once) never see a
# partial binary.
mkdir -p "$home/$ver"
stage=$(mktemp -d "$home/$ver/.install.XXXXXX")
tar -xzf "$tmp/$pkg" -C "$stage" agentflow
mv -f "$stage/agentflow" "$home/$ver/agentflow" # rename(2): atomic, last writer wins
rmdir "$stage"
ln -sfn "$home/$ver" "$home/current"
exec "$home/current/agentflow" "$@"
